title: The explicit tensor-parameter and source-Hom shift maps
statement: Let D be a preadditive closed monoidal category with additive integer shifts and a CommShift₂Int structure on its tensor bifunctor. Define t(K,n):tensorLeft(K[n]) ≅ tensorLeft(K) followed by shift n by the parameter-shift components of curriedTensor. Define siteHomSourceShift(K,n) by rightAdjointUniq between the tensor-Hom adjunction for K[n] and the composite of the shift-n adjunction with the tensor-Hom adjunction for K, transported on its left by c(K,n) followed by t(K,n) inverse. Define siteHomOppositeSourceShift(K,n) by using -n and the equality transport -(-n)=n. Define siteHomSignedSourceComponent(M,n,X) as (-1)^(n(n+1)/2) times that opposite source mate at X.unop, evaluated at M. These are the existing explicit constructions, without any new choice or shift-coherence assertion.

from.place: Proof, second paragraph: internal Hom is triangulated in the first variable and the exact comparison pullback carries triangles to triangles, so the comparison maps form morphisms of triangles. This node supplies the native signed shifts used in that clause.

def siteHomSourceShift (K : D) (n : ℤ) :
    ihom (K⟦n⟧) ≅ ihom K ⋙ shiftFunctor D (-n)
